Clinical Science Liaison (CSL) - Rio de Janeiro (Position prioritized for People with Disabilities)

Category: Medical Affairs

Location:

Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, BR

Are you passionate about science, communication, and making a meaningful impact on patients' lives? Do you enjoy translating complex data into practical insights and working in close partnership with internal teams and healthcare professionals? If so, this is your opportunity to join Novo Nordisk as a Clinical Science Liaison. Apply now and become a vital part of our medical strategy.

At Novo Nordisk, we do not wait for change; we drive change, and we are committed to providing and promoting an equal opportunity work environment while conducting our processes in an affirmative manner as part of our ongoing efforts to create and lead teams with a primary mission of diversity and inclusion. Therefore, we inform you that the selection process for this position will be prioritized for People with Disabilities.

The Position

As a Clinical Science Liaison, you will act as a key scientific resource and bridge between Novo Nordisk and the healthcare community. You will support medical strategy execution by delivering scientific content to healthcare professionals (HCPs), supporting internal stakeholders, and generating insights to guide decision-making. This role focuses on post-launch scientific engagement and internal collaboration, with no direct field visits to KOLs. Key responsibilities include:

  • Establishing strong scientific relationships with HCPs, delivering timely and relevant medical information tailored to their needs, and supporting their understanding of Novo Nordisk’s therapies in the post-launch phase.
  • Implementing local scientific communication plans, adapting language, channel, and format to audience profiles, and proactively managing territory-level initiatives and medical events.
  • Collecting and analysing structured and unstructured insights from HCPs to inform internal strategies and support portfolio development and business alignment.
  • Supporting evidence generation through collaboration on local publications, ISS projects, clinical site engagement, and local dissemination of global data and encores.
  • Partnering with internal teams, including sales, medical affairs, and training, to ensure scientific consistency and readiness, and contributing to patient journey mapping and care pathway development.

Qualifications

We’re looking for a science-driven communicator with strong cross-functional collaboration skills. To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • A medical degree with an active CRM; specialisation or clinical experience in the therapeutic area is a strong plus.
  • An advanced level of English is highly desirable.
  • Valid driver's license (CNH) and availability to travel throughout Rio de Janeiro and nearby cities (approximately 70% travel required).
  • Strong scientific literacy, critical thinking, and communication skills.
  • A collaborative, adaptable, and proactive mindset, with the ability to work in dynamic environments and contribute to data-driven planning.

About the Department

You will join the Medical Affairs team at Novo Nordisk Brazil, where we are committed to scientific excellence and meaningful partnerships. Our mission is to ensure that healthcare professionals have access to robust data, clear guidance, and ongoing support to provide the best care to patients. We collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align science with strategy — and our work makes a difference in real lives.

Working at Novo Nordisk

At Novo Nordisk, we don’t wait for change. We drive change. We’re a dynamic company in an even more dynamic industry, and we know that what got us to where we are today is not necessarily what will make us successful in the future. We embrace the spirit of experimentation, striving for excellence without fixating on perfection. We never shy away from opportunities to develop, we seize them. Working at Novo Nordisk is working toward something bigger than ourselves, and it’s a collective effort. Novo Nordisk relies on the joint potential and collaboration of its more than 69,000 employees to change the lives for the better for millions of patients living with diabetes and other chronic diseases. Together, we go further.

Contact

To complete your application, please click "Apply now" attach your CV and follow the instructions.For more information, please follow us on LinkedIn:Novo Nordisk: About | LinkedIn

Deadline

Apply before July 3rd, 2025.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants. At Novo Nordisk we recognize that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to aspire to be the best company for the world and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and communities we operate in. Together, we’re life changing.

Main responsibilities

• Trabalhar em projetos com machine learning para predição ou classificação de dados geológicos;

• Auxiliar na rotina de gerenciamento de dados do time de subsuperfície;

• Aplicação de conhecimentos da geologia de petróleo como sedimentologia, estratigrafia, sismo-estratigrafia, geoestatistica, geoquímica, cronoestratigrafia que permitam a caracterização de reservatórios de óleo e gás;

• Elaboração de planos de desenvolvimento e relatórios para ANP;

• Acompanhamento geológico e suporte a decisão durante a perfuração;

• Representar a PRIO nas parcerias e projetos estratégicos.



Requirements and skills

Formação acadêmica:

• Graduação em Geologia, Engenharia Geológica, Geofísica ou áreas correlatas;

• Pós-graduação mestrado ou doutorado em geociências, ciência de dados ou áreas afins será um diferencial.

Experiência:

• Experiência comprovada em projetos geológicos aplicados (mineração, petróleo, meio ambiente, etc.);

• Vivência com interpretação de dados geológicos, geoquímicos e/ou geofísicos;

• Histórico de atuação com grandes volumes de dados geológicos (data mining, controle de qualidade de dados, etc.);

• Inglês fluente.



Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Insurance Manager FIFA
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Job Description

The Position

The overall purpose of the Insurance Manager is to ensure the efficient implementation and supervision of the insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. He will also be the local contact person to the local Insurance Brokers.All tasks listed below shall be conducted in close collaboration with the FIFA Insurance Lead, and where needed with the FIFA Audit, Risk & Advisory subdivision.Key Responsibilities
  • Implement and monitor an appropriate local insurance solution (Personal Insurances, Property Damage and Business Interruption Insurances, Marine Cargo & Liability Insurances (e.g. General Liability incl. Medical Malpractice, D&O, Error & Omissions, Motor Liability etc.)) for all FWWC 2027 entities.
  • Monitor and advice the Host Cities, Stadium Owners, Training Site Owners in regards to the insurance requirements and make sure that all is implemented in time.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Procurement teams in order to make sure that all legal contracts, which the FWWC 2027 entities will enter with sponsors, suppliers and event contractors for services required to deliver FIFA Woman World Cup 2027, have the required adequate and appropriate insurance clauses, indemnities and warranties in place.
  • Develop, implement and monitor an appropriate insurance manual and a claim insurance administration policy & procedures, to be used by FIFA Woman World Cup 2027 stakeholders.
  • In the event of a claim (Personal, Property & Liability) to record, administer and report the claim and discuss with the FIFA Lead Insurance, local Broker and/or the insurer.
  • Being the insurance interface for the local FWWC 2027 entities for all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Identification and evaluation of potential risks and proposal of countermeasures.
  • Being part and support the implementation of a local risk management program for the FIFA Woman World Cup 2027 entities.
  • Regular organization of insurance surveys.

Your profile

  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in the insurance and risk sector.
  • Solid experience in the areas of insurance on the local Brazil markets as well as experience in risk management, insurance and contract drafting
  • Strong knowledge of the insurance laws in the Brazil. Understanding of which conditions are usual “good local standard” in Brazil.
  • Good familiarity with the market players and experience in negotiations with the local insurers
  • Proven record of accomplishment in internal risk management and insurance issues settlement (especially on local mandatory insurances and employee benefits) and understanding of how high a deductible should be set etc.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Spanish and/or German is a plus if spoken and written
  • Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Planning software and online collaboration tools (an asset)
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
ROLE PURPOSE

  • The Cost Optimization team is responsible for identifying cost reduction opportunities within Brazil Operations without compromising safety or service quality.
  • Brazil Operations is a critical business unit for SBM Offshore’s cash flow, handling 20-30% of Brazil’s oil production.
  • The cost structure of Brazil Operations is heavily focused on maintenance activities that ensure FPSOs (Floating Production Storage and Offloading units) can operate for up to 25 years in remote ocean locations, ensuring equipment reliability and the integrity of hulls and tanks.
  • The Senior Cost Controller will be a key player in this strategic initiative, requiring a blend of strategic vision and strong skills in modeling and data analysis.

RESPONSABILITIES

  • Understand the cost structure of Brazil Operations to identify areas of high expenditure within the P&L.

  • Identify and prioritize cost-reduction opportunities by assessing financial feasibility (business cases), developing projections/forecasts, and maximizing returns.

  • Lead or collaborate on cost-reduction projects with internal teams (e.g., Supply Chain, HR, Maintenance), providing critical analysis of both cost and performance data that impacts costs (e.g., productivity). This includes defining key performance indicators (KPIs), data gathering, insights generation, proposing improvements, and influencing business transformation.

  • Improve cost tracking processes by generating regular optimization reports using internal systems (e.g., ERP). Take responsibility for data from source to transformation, including dashboard creation and data flow automation. Ensure data consistency, quality, and governance, collaborating with IT.

  • Support communication initiatives to raise awareness among employees about the importance of cost management, linking it to the company’s long-term strategy.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related fields.

  • An MBA or a master’s degree in finance is highly desirable.

  • Solid experience in consulting, cost optimization, cost analysis, financial efficiency, corporate finance, financial modeling, project valuation, strategic planning, data intelligence, data analytics, business intelligence, or process optimization.

  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English (written and spoken).

  • Advanced Excel proficiency.

  • Experience with databases modeling tools (e.g., Access, Alteryx, Power Pivot/Power Query, ETL, Star Schema, OLAP, master data management, cubes, or similar), managing large datasets.

  • Basic knowledge in the following (no professional experience required):

    • SQL or any programming language.

    • Project valuation and business cases (e.g., ROI, NPV).

    • Key financial reports (balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow).

  • Basic knowledge of the Oil and Gas industry is desirable.

  • Familiarity with Maintenance Strategy and Integrity concepts is a plus.

Team Leader Resources, In-Situ

Wärtsilä Parts and Field Service is now looking for an enthusiastic Team Leader Resources, In-Situ to join our skilled team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry's transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe, and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that approximately 90% of world trade is carried by sea?

We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services- together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

What will you be doing?

As a Team Leader In-Situ Resources, you will be responsible for leading and developing a In-Situ Resources Team consisting of In-Situ Machining Engineers and Technicians in Brazil, in accordance with the strategy, action plan and business needs.

Effective July 2025, Wärtsilä Brazil will implement a new hybrid work model. Most employees who live within 65 kilometres of an office will work 6 days per month in office. This model will provide our employees the flexibility of working from home, while also providing the benefits of in-person collaboration. We will be happy to provide more information during your interview process.

This position reports to the In-Situ Resources Manager .

Candidates are expected to display a high level of critical thinking and reasoning skills, identify as high performers, as well as being self-motivating.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate the In-Situ demand during the year and define appropriate actions (including recruiting).
  • Development of your team competencies as required to address current and future needs.
  • Manage personnel responsibilities including selection, training, performance appraisal, discipline, and safety in the field. Foster team development and a continuous learning environment. Monitor team performance and provide feedback for improvement.
  • Ensure that the team is utilized effectively, having the right people in the right place at the right time.
  • Foster strategic relationships with institutes of leaning to attract and develop talent.
  • Manage and maintain internal and external relationships, focused on achieving company targets.
  • Facilitate good collaboration with key stakeholders throughout the delivery chain (Sales, Lifecycle Support, Agreements, Technical Service).
  • Contribute to the annual budget preparation and service forecast evaluations.
  • Set the individual performance and development targets of your team.
  • Monitor and control the monthly process KPIs in Resources, seeking to provide information to those responsible for identifying potential failures and improvements through action plans.
  • To comply with the company's Quality, Health & Safety and Equal Opportunities policies.
  • In addition to the above duties and responsibilities, the post holder must be prepared to undertake such additional duties within their capabilities which may result from changing circumstances, but which may not, of necessity, change the general character or level of responsibility of the post.

Main Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or technical university or equivalent work experience in a technical service-minded organization is desired
  • Job-related experience with a technical degree and/or bachelor’s degree, and some project management experience or training is required
  • Service management skills and/or experience with coordinating service teams is desirable
  • Experience with reciprocating engines and ancillary equipment in a Mechanical/Maritime environment is required
  • Thorough understanding of the Field Service process
  • English language proficiency (Spanish considered as plus)
  • Be proficient with process tools such as SalesForce (CRM), Qlikview and FS Mobility

As an ideal candidate, we expect you to have:

  • High integrity
  • Passionate about people
  • Customer focus
  • Strong focus on quality and safety
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) in languages needed to support the team
  • Good negotiating skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Team player mindset
  • Ability to lead persons of different cultural backgrounds
  • Good understand of profit and loss and cost to serve

Successful applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship.

If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know, and we will work with you to support your request.

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.

Job description

Irá atuar na área de estética como Especialista do Laser realizando procedimentos de depilação a laser seguro e eficiente aos nossosclientes.



Main responsibilities
  • Executar o procedimento técnico de depilação a laser;
  • Realizará avaliação do cliente;
  • Orientar e esclarecer dúvidas sobre nosso serviço de depilação a laser;
  • Evoluir sessões do cliente em sistema registrando parâmetros utilizados e informações sobre o tratamento no prontuário eletrônico;
  • Acompanhamento das intercorrências e dúvidas sobre o resultado do tratamento, prestando assistência e esclarecimentos ao cliente, bem como processos administrativos associados;
  • Realizar venda e revenda de pacotes de depilação a laser (on-line e/ou presencial) e receber pagamentos de acordo com a política comercial;
  • Solicitação e controle de materiais e insumos para a realização dos procedimentos clínicos;
  • Organização e higienização da sala de procedimento e dos materiais utilizados;
  • Será responsável por seguir o POP (Procedimento Operacional Padrão) e protocolos estabelecidos pela empresa;
  • Zelo e utilização correta (de acordo com os protocolos de uso) da máquina do laser, checagem do bom funcionamento e realização das manutenções preventivas de todos os equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Informar todos os clientes sobre a pesquisa NPS, incentivando a avaliação para melhoria contínua do nosso relacionamento.


Requirements and skills

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Estética e Cosmetologia (reconhecida pelo MEC e ter a carteira do CNPB ou CRBM ativa);
  • Formação superior em Biomedicina com Habilitação ou Pós Graduação Completa em Estética (ter a carteira do CRBM ativa);
  • Formação superior completa em Fisioterapia, crefito ativo (do estado que irá atuar);
  • Desejável experiência com atendimento ao público, captação de clientes e vendas;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semanas por escala.


Additional information

  • Salário fixo + bonificações por metas atingidas;
  • Vale transporte;

  • Vale alimentação;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Parceria de desconto com a Zenklub – (plataforma online de saúde emocional);
  • Day Off – (uma folga no mês do aniversário);
  • Parcerias educacionais com universidades e cursos de idiomas;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Quantitative Analyst
description:
We are the Latin American branch of Match Group, the world's largest company for dating websites and apps. You've probably heard of some of our brands: Match.com, Tinder, OkCupid, Par Perfeito, Divino Amor, Our Time, Hinge, Stir, and many more!

Our mission is simple: to create meaningful connections for every person everywhere. Passion drives us, and we believe in love. We are relentless in our pursuit to build and integrate technology that will help connect people.

Currently, the group's brands worldwide include:

  • Par Perfeito - a pioneering brand in Brazil and the largest in online serious relationships.
  • Hinge - an inclusive dating app for real people looking to meet others and pursue real-life relationships.
  • POF - a dating website for people seeking casual or serious relationships.
  • Match.com - the world's largest dating site.
  • Tinder - the leading global app to meet new people.

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Match, Hinge, PlentyOfFish, The League, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.

The Match Growth & Revenue team is looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join their newly formed Data Science pod. This new position is an exciting opportunity to apply insights and identify wins across our portfolio of brands (including Match, OKCupid, and PlentyOfFish). The role will drive tangible business impact through the analysis of test results and ecosystem trends, collaboration with our Product and Development groups, and quantitative research on how our users find love.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for doing our best work so we work together IRL in our Dallas office 2 days/week.

How You'll Make An Impact:
  • Liaise with individual brands to understand their business models, track ecosystem trends, and identify opportunities across the portfolio
  • Conduct quantitative research to better understand user behavior and inform future initiatives
  • Collaborate with other teams, including Product and Development, to shepherd projects from ideation to delivery
  • Propose and design tests for discounting, merchandising, and pricing, with a focus on cross-brand applicability
  • Monitor AB tests, including identifying opportunities for segmentation and iteration, and modelling the long-term ecosystem and revenue impacts.
  • Improve consistency and efficiency of internal querying, reporting, and dashboarding processes
We Could Be A Match If:
  • You have 3+ years of experience in a role related to business analytics or product analytics
  • You are proficient in SQL (MSSQL and/or Redshift preferred)
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office and/or Google Drive apps, especially Excel/Sheets
  • You are proficient in statistical software such as R or Python
  • You have a sound understanding of statistics and modelling techniques
  • You have the ability to work collaboratively on a diverse team, featuring colleagues of different backgrounds, specialties, and levels of technical knowledge
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent knowledge) or higher in business, economics, mathematics, quantitative social sciences, statistics, or related field
Why work with us?

Our mission is simple - to help people find love and happiness! We also take great care of our employees.

Here at Match Group LatAm, you'll have:

  • Autonomy to develop in a light, fun, and technological environment that encourages innovation through technology;
  • Flexibility for work and hours;
  • Competitive salary package and bonuses, according to company policy;
  • Competitive meal voucher/meal allowance;
  • Health and dental plan, extendable to spouse and dependents for employees (not included for interns);
  • Gympass to take care of your health even more;
  • Home Office Assistance: every month you will receive an allowance to contribute to home office expenses;
  • Incentive to participate in events;
  • Udemy for Business: You'll have access to the Udemy platform, which offers over 183,000 online courses in various areas, on-demand;
  • In-Company English: We have an in-company English teacher to help develop your second language. The company covers 80% of the costs and the employee covers 20%;
  • Annual Check-up: To take care of our team's well-being, we offer an annual medical check-up for all employees aged 40+, promoting health and well-being through preventive medicine;
  • "Baby Bonding Leave" - extended paternity leave. Here at #Match, we believe that caring for the next generation is a gender-neutral investment. As soon as an employee's baby is born, the father takes 100% paid leave for 12 weeks.
  • International Career Opportunities: We have several cases of employees who have been expatriated to contribute to Match Group in other countries. Here, you have the autonomy and freedom of a local company, with the structure and resources of a global corporation.

We hope you feel excited to join our team, with the autonomy to bring your ideas to life without worrying about bureaucracy and rigid hierarchies.
